sources.snippet: A modern, responsive AI Text Detector application built with Next.js, Chadcn UI, and Framer Motion. The app supports multiple languages (English, French, Arabic) with RTL support and features beautiful animations. Now powered by Hugging Face AI models for real AI detection!

sources.title: Desklib AI Text Detector - GitHub
sources.snippet: Desklib AI Text Detector This repository contains the code and resources for an AI-generated text detection model developed by Desklib. This model is designed to classify English text as either human-written or AI-generated.
